page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 72 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 288.0 GB of system memory, which establishes a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, with a GPU count of 0.0. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile represents a standard general-purpose resource density, balancing compute capacity and memory allocation. Because it lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, the instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that rely heavily on network-attached storage and standard CPU processing. Appropriate workloads include enterprise applications, web serving, distributed systems, and general-purpose business applications that require high vCPU counts and moderate memory without the need for local NVMe drives or hardware acceleration.
